title: Xbox boss Asha Sharma reveals new division in response to AI mash-up games
key_facts: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced a new division, Xbox Labs, in a statement on X.
Radio Times says people are using AI to fuse the source code of different games; a Minecraft and Elden Ring mash-up is described as the most popular.
Sharma wrote that many of the biggest games have been 'remixed into the source code of another'.

Xbox Labs is described as a small group of game makers, engineers and scientists, set up by 'Scott' (surname not given in the article), that will build in the open and share its tools with developers.
Radio Times notes Xbox opens it after mass industry layoffs, and says what Xbox Labs will do is vague.
Capcom said at a recent tech conference it plans to fuse its game engine with AI.
quote_evidence: "Perhaps more surprisingly, we've seen many of the biggest games in the world have been remixed into the source code of another."
"To explore these possibilities, I've asked Scott to stand-up Xbox Labs, a small group of game makers, engineers and scientists..."
What the work of Xbox Labs will actually involve is vague.
why_it_matters_hint: Xbox is setting up an AI experimentation group after AI game mash-ups went viral.
notes: Date of the X post not stated in the article text; Radio Times carried it 14 Oct. Mash-up claims are Radio Times'.
